segments.text: No, because why is eating in the morning the hardest thing to do?
This feeling is actually pretty common.
Your body has a natural circadian rhythm that makes hunger hit its lowest point around 8AM.
Growl in, your hunger hormone is naturally suppressed in the morning hours.
On the other hand, hunger and appetite peak later in the evening, which may be your body's
way of preparing for fasting overnight.
Oh, and poor sleep messes with your hunger hormones completely.
So if your stomach is silent at 8 a.m. but loud at 8 p.m., now you know why.
